description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: Four rounded bamboo cradles rise above a shallow woven catch tray. Side: Each cradle has an offset upper notch for a lid handle. Rear: The rear spine joins all cradles and shows individual wrapped attachments. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
